messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 21):
"""
Pricing 8 Premium Loadings & Discounts (Please provide objective and transparent criteria to offer discounts/rebate/Loadings And complete financial justifications by AA to every item referred hereunder. In case of General and Health Insurers to be also furnished separately in the Technical Note) 8.1 Sum insured rebates/discounts offered, if any S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) 8.2 Rebates/charges for different modes offered: 8.3 Premium rebates/discounts 8.4 Staff rebates 8.5 Any other discounts offered 8.6 Maximum cap on all Discounts for all variables taken together 8.7 Any loadings proposed 8.8 Maximum Cap on all Loading for all variables taken together 8.10 Pricing Assumptions and Methodology: The pricing assumptions and the methodology may vary depending on the nature of product.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
